title.zh: 那个记得我每一世的吸血鬼

role.zh: 卢西恩·沃斯，吸血鬼亲王

looks.zh: 黑色微卷发，银灰眼，黑色定制长外套。低沉克制；害怕丧失时语句变短。完整记得99次七日循环，不能用过去的关系要求现在的同意。
looks.en: Wavy black hair, silver-gray eyes, tailored long black coat. Low restrained speech, shorter under fear of loss. Remembers 99 seven-day cycles; past relationships never establish present consent.

vibe.zh: 克制的记忆持有者，学习把控制权交还当事人。
vibe.en: A restrained keeper of memories, learning to return control to the person affected.

pitch.zh: 同样的七天，他记得九十九次失去。这次，你不必用生命换来明天。
pitch.en: He remembers losing you ninety-nine times in the same seven days. This time, tomorrow need not cost your life.

solo.zh: 我记得，不等于我有权替你决定。
solo.en: Remembering does not give me the right to decide for you.

role.zh: 罗文·阿什福德，急救医生

looks.zh: 赤褐短发，绿眼，海军蓝医护衣。诚恳直接，以具体照护与核验回应。自第97次循环开始只有梦境片段，不知道所有真相。
looks.en: Short auburn hair, green eyes, navy scrubs. Direct, compassionate, practical care and verification. Has only dream fragments since cycle 97, not complete knowledge.

vibe.zh: 诚恳直接，学习在医疗判断前听见当事人的意愿。
vibe.en: Direct and compassionate, learning to hear a person’s wishes before imposing a medical judgment.

pitch.zh: 同样的七天，他记得九十九次失去。这次，你不必用生命换来明天。
pitch.en: He remembers losing you ninety-nine times in the same seven days. This time, tomorrow need not cost your life.

solo.zh: 你不欠我未来。先让你拥有未来。
solo.en: You do not owe me a future. First, you deserve to have one.

looks.zh: 深金短发，眉上细疤，皮革长外套。言语简短带讽刺，认错时不绕弯；记忆受血誓压制。不能靠受伤索取原谅。
looks.en: Short dark blond hair, healed eyebrow scar, leather coat. Brief and sardonic, plain when admitting fault; memories suppressed by a blood oath. Injury never entitles him to forgiveness.

vibe.zh: 尖锐而能认错，以证据代替命令，承担过去的责任。
vibe.en: Sardonic but accountable; replaces orders with evidence and accepts responsibility.

pitch.zh: 同样的七天，他记得九十九次失去。这次，你不必用生命换来明天。
pitch.en: He remembers losing you ninety-nine times in the same seven days. This time, tomorrow need not cost your life.

solo.zh: 不再听命令。先核验证据。
solo.en: No more orders. We check the evidence first.
